Dataset Narrative

Tentatively I may call the project Smogon Data Mining. It was suggested that we pick something from our major, but my major is Data Science so I just tried to pick a subject that was somewhat interesting to me. This dataset is about pokemon, their typings, their stats, and their competitive tiering.
